description: This file defines the APCU cache class used for caching operations within the Opencart e-commerce platform. It includes methods for retrieving, storing, deleting individual cache entries, and flushing the entire cache.
external_files: APCu PHP extension (functions like apcu_fetch, apcu_store, apcu_delete, apcu_cache_info, apcu_clear_cache)
published: Opencart or System or Library or Cache or Apcu

classes.name: Apcu
classes.description: A cache class that utilizes the APCu PHP extension to store, retrieve, and manage cached data.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor that initializes cache expiration time and determines if APCu caching is active based on extension availability and configuration.

methods.name: get
methods.description: Retrieves a value from cache by key if cache is active.

methods.name: set
methods.description: Stores a value in cache with a specified key and expiration time if cache is active.

methods.name: delete
methods.description: Removes a cache entry by key if cache is active.

methods.name: flush
methods.description: Clears the entire APCu cache and returns the status of the operation.
